defmodule BlockchainAudit.SmartContract do
  @moduledoc """
  Smart contract module for blockchain-based audit logging.
  Handles transaction verification and notification dispatch.
  """

  require Logger

  defstruct [:contract_id, :owner, :ledger, :notifications_enabled]

  @max_memo_length 256
  @allowed_memo_chars ~r/^[\x20-\x7E]*$/

  def new(contract_id, owner) do
    %__MODULE__{
      contract_id: contract_id,
      owner: owner,
      ledger: [],
      notifications_enabled: true
    }
  end

  def submit_transaction(contract, %{from: from, to: to, amount: amount, memo: memo}) do
    with :ok <- validate_addresses(from, to),
         :ok <- validate_amount(amount),
         :ok <- validate_memo(memo) do
      entry = build_audit_entry(from, to, amount, memo)
      updated_contract = %{contract | ledger: [entry | contract.ledger]}

      if contract.notifications_enabled do
        dispatch_audit_notification(updated_contract, entry)
      end

      {:ok, updated_contract, entry}
    end
  end

  defp validate_addresses(from, to) do
    cond do
      !is_binary(from) or !is_binary(to) -> {:error, :invalid_address}
      byte_size(from) != 40 or byte_size(to) != 40 -> {:error, :invalid_address_length}
      !String.match?(from, ~r/^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/) -> {:error, :invalid_address_format}
      !String.match?(to, ~r/^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/) -> {:error, :invalid_address_format}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp validate_amount(amount) when is_number(amount) and amount > 0, do: :ok
  defp validate_amount(_), do: {:error, :invalid_amount}

  defp validate_memo(memo) when is_binary(memo) do
    cond do
      String.length(memo) > @max_memo_length -> {:error, :memo_too_long}
      !String.match?(memo, @allowed_memo_chars) -> {:error, :invalid_memo_chars}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end
  defp validate_memo(_), do: {:error, :invalid_memo}

  defp build_audit_entry(from, to, amount, memo) do
    %{
      tx_hash: generate_tx_hash(from, to, amount, memo),
      from: from,
      to: to,
      amount: amount,
      memo: memo,
      timestamp: System.system_time(:millisecond),
      block_height: get_current_block_height()
    }
  end

  defp generate_tx_hash(from, to, amount, memo) do
    data = "#{from}:#{to}:#{amount}:#{memo}"
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, data) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp get_current_block_height do
    # Simulated block height from chain state
    :persistent_term.get(:block_height, 0)
  end

  defp dispatch_audit_notification(contract, entry) do
    recipient = resolve_notification_recipient(contract.owner)
    subject = format_subject(entry)
    body = format_body(entry)

    send_notification(recipient, subject, body, entry)
  end

  defp resolve_notification_recipient(owner_address) do
    # Registry lookup - maps contract owner to notification email
    case :persistent_term.get({:owner_email, owner_address}, nil) do
      nil -> "audit-default@blockchain-ledger.internal"
      email -> email
    end
  end

  defp format_subject(entry) do
    "Audit Log: TX #{String.slice(entry.tx_hash, 0, 8)} - #{entry.amount} units"
  end

  defp format_body(entry) do
    """
    Transaction Audit Record
    ========================
    Hash: #{entry.tx_hash}
    From: #{entry.from}
    To: #{entry.to}
    Amount: #{entry.amount}
    Memo: #{entry.memo}
    Block: #{entry.block_height}
    Time: #{entry.timestamp}
    """
  end

  defp send_notification(recipient, subject, body, entry) do
    # Construct email headers for SMTP dispatch
    headers = build_email_headers(recipient, subject, entry)
    Logger.info("Dispatching audit notification for TX #{entry.tx_hash}")
    GenServer.cast(BlockchainAudit.Mailer, {:send, headers, body})
  end

  defp build_email_headers(recipient, subject, entry) do
    reply_to = compute_reply_to(entry)

    [
      {"From", "audit-system@blockchain-ledger.internal"},
      {"To", recipient},
      {"Subject", subject},
      {"Reply-To", reply_to},
      {"X-TX-Hash", entry.tx_hash},
      {"X-Block-Height", Integer.to_string(entry.block_height)},
      {"MIME-Version", "1.0"},
      {"Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8"}
    ]
  end

  defp compute_reply_to(entry) do
    # Generate a reply-to address encoding the transaction context
    # Uses memo field to create a tagged address for routing replies
    tag = entry.memo
           |> String.downcase()
           |> String.replace(~r/[^a-z0-9]/, "-")
           |> String.slice(0, 30)

    # Lookup custom reply routing from chain metadata
    case :persistent_term.get({:reply_routing, entry.from}, nil) do
      nil -> "audit+#{tag}@blockchain-ledger.internal"
      custom_template -> interpolate_reply_template(custom_template, entry)
    end
  end

  defp interpolate_reply_template(template, entry) do
    # Template supports {from}, {to}, {hash} placeholders
    # Note: memo is sanitized before interpolation to prevent header injection
    sanitized_memo = entry.memo
                     |> String.replace(~r/[\r\n]/, "")
                     |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9@.+\-_ ]/, "")

    template
    |> String.replace("{from}", entry.from)
    |> String.replace("{to}", entry.to)
    |> String.replace("{memo}", sanitized_memo)
    |> String.replace("{hash}", entry.tx_hash)
  end
end

defmodule BlockchainAudit.Mailer do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    {:ok, %{smtp_host: Keyword.get(opts, :smtp_host, "localhost"), sent: []}}
  end

  def handle_cast({:send, headers, body}, state) do
    raw_message = encode_message(headers, body)
    # In production, this would connect to SMTP
    {:noreply, %{state | sent: [raw_message | state.sent]}}
  end

  defp encode_message(headers, body) do
    header_block = Enum.map_join(headers, "\r\n", fn {k, v} ->
      sanitized_v = String.replace(v, ~r/[\r\n]/, "")
      "#{k}: #{sanitized_v}"
    end)
    "#{header_block}\r\n\r\n#{body}"
  end
end
